description: A Perl script that analyzes the output of 'git verify-pack -v' to generate statistics about Git pack files, including sizes, path sizes, delta trees, and depths. It can also output detailed tree structures and filenames associated with objects.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical measures (count, total, min, max, mean, median, std_dev) for a list of numeric data.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Prints formatted statistical summary for a dataset.

methods.name: dig
methods.description: Recursively traverses object trees, accumulating sizes and path sizes, and optionally printing tree structure.
